title: Net 30 is due 30 days after the invoice date
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin at the test location.
  • Make sure customer A holds Net 30.
  • Make sure work order 1 for customer A is complete and ready to invoice (every part received, review done).
  • If you cannot set up any of the above, mark this test Blocked: "setup not done".
custom_steps:
1. Open work order 1's Finance tab.
  2. Set Invoice Date to Oct 5, 2026.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • The invoice preview shows Invoice Date and Due date.

Step 2:

  • The Due date reads Nov 4, 2026 (Oct 5 + 30 days: 26 days to Oct 31, then 4 into November).

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "Credit terms", Confluence 963346440, version 3 (22 Oct 2026, "Renamed to Credit terms", Chris Ward), read 23 Oct 2026 · Epic SV-11638, story SV-11676 (Story 7, Due dates)

  • S7-R1: “A Net term (standard or the shop's own) is due that many days after the invoice date: an invoice dated Oct 5 on Net 30 is due Nov 4; on a shop's "Net 10" it is due Oct 15.”
